units.source_text: “我是个孤独的人，”先生说，

en.t: "I am a lonely person," Sensei said,

units.source_text: “很高兴你来看我，所以才问你为什么这样频繁来访。”

en.t: "I am glad that you come to see me, and that is why I asked why you visit so often."

units.source_text: “这又是为了什么？”

en.t: "And why is that?"

units.source_text: 我这样反问时，先生没有回答，只是看着我，

en.t: When I asked him back in that way, Sensei did not answer; he only looked at me,

units.source_text: 问道：“你多大了？”

en.t: and asked, "How old are you?"

units.source_text: 先生这样的回答，令我茫然不解，不过那时我并没有追究到底就回去了。

en.t: Sensei's answer left me completely puzzled, but at the time I did not press the matter and went home.

units.source_text: 而且不到四天的工夫，我又去看望先生了。

en.t: Then, before even four days had passed, I went to visit Sensei again.

units.source_text: 先生一进客厅，就笑着说道：“又来了。”

en.t: As soon as Sensei entered the sitting room, he smiled and said, "Here you are again."

units.source_text: “唉，又来了。”说着，我自己也笑了。

en.t: "Yes, here I am again," I said, and I laughed too.

units.source_text: 要是别人这样说，我肯定会生气。

en.t: If anyone else had said that to me, I would certainly have been offended.

units.source_text: 可是先生这样说，恰恰相反，我不但没有生气，反而觉得很愉快。

en.t: But when Sensei said it, the effect was just the opposite: instead of being offended, I felt rather pleased.

units.source_text: “我是个孤独的人，”那天晚上，先生又说了一遍前几天的那句话，

en.t: "I am a lonely person," Sensei said again that evening, repeating the words he had spoken a few days before,

units.source_text: “我是个孤独的人，也许你也是个孤独的人吧。

en.t: "I am a lonely person, and perhaps you are a lonely person too.

units.source_text: 我虽然孤独，但上了年纪，闷在家里也无所谓，可你还年轻，不会这样下去的吧？

en.t: Though I am lonely, I am older, so I can stay shut up at home without minding it; but you are still young, and surely you cannot go on like that, can you?

units.source_text: 你一定是精力充沛得无处发泄吧？

en.t: You must be so full of energy that you have nowhere to spend it, mustn't you?

units.source_text: 想要跟什么较较劲吧……”

en.t: You must want to throw yourself against something and test your strength..."

units.source_text: “我一点儿也不觉得孤独。”

en.t: "I do not feel lonely at all."

units.source_text: “没有比年轻的时候更让人感觉孤独的了，

en.t: "There is no time when one feels lonelier than when one is young,

units.source_text: 否则你为什么老往我家跑呢？”

en.t: otherwise why would you keep coming to my house so often?"

units.source_text: 这时，先生又重复了前几天说过的话。

en.t: At this point, Sensei again repeated what he had said a few days before.
